title: Hypercontractivity from normalized tests
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p,q\in[0,\infty]$ be nonzero, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Suppose that for every $a,b\in\mathbb R$ with $a=1$ or $b=1$, the uniform $q$-norm of $x\mapsto a+\rho bX(x)$ is at most the uniform $p$-norm of $x\mapsto a+bX(x)$. Then this inequality holds for every $a,b\in\mathbb R$.
hypotheses_covered: The norm inequality holds whenever $a=1$ or $b=1$
